We are looking for talented, service-minded individuals who want to grow their careers in a supportive, relationship-focused environment. Our team members are essential to our success, and we invest in them through training, development, and opportunities to advance. This is not a remote position. It is on-site in Oklahoma City. Summary Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, the IT Security Engineer supports the Bank with the development, implementation, and maintenance of a strategic and comprehensive enterprise-wide Information Security/Cybersecurity Program designed to ensure proper protection of the Bank’s data, systems, information assets, intellectual property, and the Bank’s reputation. Primary Duties/Responsibilities Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Under the guidance and direction of the Chief Technology Officer, oversees the management and operations of information security and cybersecurity tools, documentation, standards, and processes to ensure an operating environment that is effective, sound, secure, sustainable, scalable, and compliant with Bank policies and regulatory requirements. Provides information and cyber risk guidance for IT projects, including the evaluation and recommendation of technical controls and security policies and procedures. Monitors developments and trends in information security and cybersecurity and formulates strategy accordingly. Works with key individuals throughout the organization to develop business cases for new security projects and risk assessments of existing and planned information systems. Supports a proactive culture to align activities and measurement with internal policy and regulatory requirements. Fosters collaborative and cooperative working relationships with security stakeholders, including IT team members, executive leadership, operations, business lines, risk management, and internal audit. Prepares and presents accurate and timely information in response to audits and regulatory exams. Develops effective relationships with the internal audit department. Provides support and collaborative mentorship to the IT team on information security and cybersecurity matters. Supports IT team members on escalations of security incidents by providing subject matter expertise and guidance. Provides leadership and technical and administrative support for the bank’s disaster recovery and business continuity program and implements appropriate and effective controls to mitigate identified risks and threats. Under the direction of the Chief Technology Officer, leads incident response to security events with a high degree of personal accountability. Utilizes incident response procedures and workflows for triage, analysis, notification, escalation, containment, remediation, and reporting. Monitors access to all systems and maintains access control profiles on the network and systems. Tracks documentation of access authorization to all IT resources. Installs, modifies, enhances, and maintains data system security software and performs application/network penetration tests and firewall auditing. Supports improved security awareness, including awareness and development of controls and detection solutions to address malware, cybersecurity, and advanced or persistent attacks. Supports a continuous monitoring framework by effectively reporting the Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and Key Control Indicators (KCIs). Assists with penetration testing, results analysis, recommendations, remediation planning and implementation, and reporting. Provides after-hours and weekend analysis on an as-needed basis outside of general working hours. Other duties as assigned by the Chief Technology Officer. Highly proficient in communicating security-related concepts to technical and non-technical staff, acting as a bridge between IT and business process owners. Strong project management aptitude and demonstrated professionalism in managing multiple projects and resources effectively. Detail-oriented with a sense of urgency and commitment to positive results. Ability to troubleshoot programs. Must be a critical thinker who can handle complex problems and find solutions. Strong work ethic with the ability to manage a large workload within tight deadlines. Excellent organizational skills with the ability to work independently, handle multiple tasks, prioritize, and meet project deadlines. Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with executive leadership, peers, managers, vendors, and contractors. Ability to exercise sound judgment in evaluating situations and in making decisions. Highly committed to continual learning and maintaining knowledge of emerging technologies and security controls. Ability to work well within a team as well as independently with minimal oversight and direction. The Engineer works closely with cybersecurity, network engineering, systems engineering, Information System Security Managers/Officers (ISSM/ISSO), and government stakeholders to develop secure, compliant, and operationally effective CSfC solutions. The CSfC capability is known as Virtual Secure – Remote (ViSR) and supports remote SIPRNet access for up to 2,000 concurrent users initially but could be scalable up to 15,000 concurrent users as the Government continues to onboard users. Experience using CLI, APIs, scripting, or automation to execute repeatable infrastructure work, including Python, vendor APIs, AI tools, or comparable technologies. Experience developing and maintaining technical standards, runbooks, diagrams, and as-built documentation and supporting planned maintenance and incidents across time zones. Preferred Experience supporting international network environments, including higher-latency or regulated locations. Experience with Netskope or another SASE platform in a production environment. Experience with Microsoft 365 room accounts, calendar integration, or conditional access. CCNA, CCNP, PCNSE, Zoom or Microsoft Teams voice/rooms certification, AVIXA CTS, or equivalent experience. Experience with cloud networking, zero-trust architecture, or infrastructure-as-code. Demonstrates willingness and capability to leverage emerging technology, automation, and AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and speed. Exercises sound judgment, creative thinking, and accountability for outcomes. Hiring Salary Range of: $83,000 - $114,000. Salary and whole compensation package (bonus target & LTI (Long Term Incentives) to be determined by the candidate’s location, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. While we are one company, locations and departments operate with autonomy and accountability. Individuals take the initiative here. When you join Prologis, you work shoulder to shoulder with some of the top talent in the industry to do the best work of your career. Every employee belongs. Every employee contributes. Employees advance their careers here. As a successful global enterprise, Prologis has never lost sight of what matters most, our strong belief that our people are the most important part of our business. And because of that, we provide a generous total rewards package and take a lot of time to focus on quality management and leadership development. People come first here. Prologis also offers several other wellness, financial, and work/lifestyle-specific benefits. Our 401(k) retirement plan has a company match of 50% up to 12% of eligible compensation. We also offer generous PTO with a starting accrual of 22 days a year in addition to paid holidays and volunteer time. All job offers are contingent upon successful completion of background verification. Prologis is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religions, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
